name: us027-three-url-forms
description: US1 AC1 (027): three designators in three different SURFACE forms — upper-case key, lower-case key (normalises), and a key with a trailing CR (Windows paste artifact, D10) — resolve to three keys in ONE bulkfetch, no parent designator, no parent lookup of any kind. Literal browse/board URLs are not expressible here: the mock's own base URL is only known once the harness has started it, so a URL-shaped designator cannot be pre-baked into static argv (host-match would fail against whichever ephemeral base a given run assigns) — the URL-reduction grammar itself is proven byte-identical across ports at the unit level instead (tests/bash/sink/test_designator.bats, tests/powershell/sink/Designator.Tests.ps1, D2-D4).
